name: no_docs
description: Ablation: the model operates WITHOUT the curated grid2op docs / AGENTS.md / recipes — the sandbox builds a docs-less workspace (OPENCODE_NO_DOCS=1, set by run_llm.start_backend) and the model must discover the sim API on its own (from simctl --help and error messages). Measures the value of in-context domain knowledge (the most predictive ablation per R2).
